ja: この設計だと、あとで機能を追加できますか？
en: Can we add features later with this design?
alternatives: With this design, can we add features later?
Can we add more features later with this design?
point: 「できますか」は Can we で文を始める

ja: このサービスを分割したら、レイテンシがどれくらい増えるか誰か分かる？
en: Does anyone know how much latency we'd add if we split this service?
alternatives: Does anybody know how much extra latency we'd get if we split this service?
Does anyone know how much the latency would go up if we split this service?
point: 間接疑問は how much latency we'd add の語順

ja: 僕たちが去年メッセージキューを選んでいたら、今こんなにタイムアウトで苦労していないはずだよね。
en: If we had chosen a message queue last year, we wouldn't be struggling with these timeouts now.
alternatives: If we'd gone with a message queue last year, we wouldn't be struggling with all these timeouts now.
If we'd picked a message queue last year, we wouldn't be having all these timeout problems now.
point: 過去の条件は had chosen、今の結果は wouldn't be

ja: マイクロサービスのほうが柔軟だとしても、うちくらいの規模のチームには複雑すぎると私は思います。
en: Even if the microservice approach is more flexible, I think it adds too much complexity for a team of our size.
alternatives: Even if microservices are more flexible, I think they're too complex for a team our size.
Even if a microservice architecture is more flexible, I think it's too complicated for a team of our size.
point: 「〜だとしても」は even if で始める

ja: テックリードに、キャッシュ層を追加する前にトレードオフをまとめてもらうよう頼んでもらえますか？
en: Could you ask the tech lead to write up the trade-offs before we add a caching layer?
alternatives: Can you ask the tech lead to write up the trade-offs before we add a caching layer?
Could you ask the tech lead to lay out the trade-offs before we add a cache layer?
point: ask＋人＋to do。「まとめる」は write up が自然

ja: 私たちは今、二つの案を比べているところです。
alternatives: We're comparing two ideas right now.
Right now we're comparing two options.

ja: 私たちがモノリスに決めたのは、速さじゃなくて運用コストが理由だったんです。
en: It was the operating cost, not the speed, that made us choose the monolith.
alternatives: It was operating costs, not speed, that made us go with the monolith.
What made us choose the monolith was the operating cost, not the speed.
point: It was A, not B, that ～ で理由を強調する

ja: そのキャッシュ設計で確定する前に、私たちに少しフィードバックをいただけますか？
en: Could you give us some feedback on the caching design before we commit to it?
alternatives: Could you give us a bit of feedback on the caching design before we lock it in?
Would you mind giving us some feedback on the caching design before we commit to it?
point: feedback は数えられない名詞。a feedback や feedbacks にしない
